_comment: Admission candidate = the incoming operator entry being evaluated against the active policy. Each field maps 1:1 to the AdmissionCandidate struct in pkg/tbtc/signer/src/bin/admission_checker.rs (consumed via #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)] is not set on this struct, so this leading _comment is silently ignored at deserialize time). incident_response_contact is optional and validated only when the policy has require_incident_response_contact=true.
